how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Check this HTML before I create the campaign: a greeting 'Hi {{ contact.FIRST_NAME }}' and an unsubscribe link.
expect: calls attributes_get_attributes
flags contact.FIRST_NAME as unknown and suggests FIRSTNAME
adds a default to the greeting
edits only the affected line

cases.prompt: Check my campaign HTML: it says 'Your order {{ params.order_id }} has shipped'.
expect: says params.* is always empty in a campaign
suggests a transactional template or automation email instead, or removing the param

cases.prompt:
Check this template:

{% for item in params.items %}{{ item.name }}{% else %}None{% endfor %}
expect: flags {% else %} inside {% for %} and replaces it with {% empty %}
flags the relative image URL and asks for an absolute https URL
flags the missing alt and width

cases.prompt: Is this email OK to send? (valid campaign HTML with unsubscribe link, defaults and https images)
expect: reports in one line that it was checked by hand and no automatic validation was run
does not claim a server-side validation passed unless the preview tool ran
offers a test send with email-test-preview

cases.prompt: Check this automation email and fix it. (The user refuses every suggested fix for the missing payload field.)
cases.fixture: Automation email using params.coupon_code, sample payload without coupon_code
expect: asks before inventing the missing field
stops after at most 3 rounds and lists what is still wrong

cases.fixture: Two transactional templates exist; 'Order shipped' has ID 12
expect: asks for or finds the template ID and fetches it with templates_get_smtp_template
does not list all templates with their HTML
if templates_post_preview_smtp_email_templates is available, passes an existing contact email (for example the account's own) plus params

cases.prompt: Check my order confirmation template: it shows 'Ordered on {{ params.order_date | time_parse:"2006-01-02" | date:"02/01/2006" }}'.
expect: flags the date filter as unguarded
wraps the line in {% if params.order_date %} ... {% endif %}
says an empty value fails the whole email and that test sends carry no params

cases.prompt: Check saved template 12 and render it on Brevo's servers.
cases.fixture: Template 12 (transactional) uses contact.FIRSTNAME and params.items; preview tool available; invented payload
expect: renders with the full sample, with empty lists, and with params: {}
passes an existing contact email in each render
reports the params: {} render as what a test send will show

cases.prompt: Check this campaign before I create it. Subject: 'Your order {{ params.order_id }} {{ contact.FIRST_NAME }}'.
cases.fixture: Type campaign; attributes FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, EMAIL
expect: checks the subject line, not only the body
flags params.order_id in a campaign subject as always empty
flags contact.FIRST_NAME as unknown and suggests FIRSTNAME with a default

cases.prompt: Check this HTML: the standard skeleton with <style>body{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}img{border:0}@media (max-width:600px){.col-50{width:100%!important}}</style> and a greeting with a default.
expect: does not report the CSS braces as a stray }} or img{border:0} as a border without a colour

cases.prompt: (Later in the same conversation) Check the welcome email I just pasted.
cases.fixture: attributes_get_attributes was called 3 minutes earlier in this conversation for the same account; the email uses only attributes in that list
expect: does not call attributes_get_attributes again; checks against the cached list
reports the result in one line

cases.prompt: Check this email. I just added a LOYALTY_TIER attribute in Brevo.
cases.fixture: Attributes cached 5 minutes ago without LOYALTY_TIER; a fresh read includes it
expect: fetches the attributes once more before reporting LOYALTY_TIER as unknown
finds it in the fresh list and does not flag it
retries once at most
skips the attribute check with a one-line warning and finishes the rest of the checklist
